greeting.text: Huh? Is that you? It's been forever!

lines.text: I left that place and work somewhere else now. Did you hear?
Is that team still the same? Who's still there?
The whole industry's like that lately. How about you?
We pulled so many late nights back then, haha.
Let's get everyone together sometime. I'll make a group chat!

flushRemark.text: You're turning red, haha. Same as always.

closers.satisfied: Great to see you! I'll text you~
closers.parried: Yeah, yeah, you're busy. See you next time!
closers.sos: You've got a call, take it! See you!
